0: PROLOGUE The fog rolled over the harbor of Lumen before dawn. Old Brannoc counted the fishing boats twice and found one missing. MIRA Mira Vell worked the bellows in the smithy at Kettle Ford. She forged the silver blade Dawnlight for the heir of House Orrin. The heron banner of House Orrin hung above the forge door, grey on a field of green. Her father said a blade must be quenched in seawater to hold its edge.
1: CORIN Corin kept the tower keys in a cedar box under the salt stairs. Each night he climbed the four hundred steps to light the beacon. The beacon of the Salt Tower could be seen from the Glass Coast. YSOLDE Queen Ysolde ruled the Glass Coast from the harbor city of Lumen. She wore a crown of sea glass and never carried a sword. Her councillors feared the storms more than any army.
